description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelActor, focusing on connection behaviors like concurrent connection handling, failure scenarios, and structured authentication failure responses.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A test suite for GatewayChannelActor connection behaviors, including concurrency, failure, and authentication error handling.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session that responds with preset fake responses to simulate different server conditions.

methods.name: `concurrent connect is single flight on success`
methods.description: Tests that multiple concurrent calls to connect only result in a single connection attempt when the connection succeeds.

methods.name: `concurrent connect shares failure`
methods.description: Tests that multiple concurrent connect attempts result in failures sharing the same failure response.

methods.name: `connect surfaces structured auth failure`
methods.description: Tests that an authentication failure during connection is correctly surfaced as a structured GatewayConnectAuthError with detailed info.
